competences.description: Attacks the enemy to stun for 1 turn with a 30% chance.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease Defense for 2 turns with an 80% chance, and you go under the Threat state while the enemy attacks with a single-target skill 1 time. Afterwards, you receive {shadow_pt} for 1 turn.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

The enemy can only attack the target under the Threat state when using the attack skill. The duration of the Threat will be reduced only by skills that attack a single enemy target. The target under the Threat state will be inflicted with 15% less damage when attacked.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies to silence them for 2 turns and absorbs their Attack Bar by 50% each. Afterwards, you go under the Threat state while the enemy attacks with a single-target skill 1 time and receive {shadow_pt} for 1 turn.

effets.description: Skills with cooldowns will be locked. (Passive skills not included)
Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself

The enemy can only attack the target under the Threat state when using the attack skill. The duration of the Threat will be reduced only by skills that attack a single enemy target. The target under the Threat state will be inflicted with 15% less damage when attacked.
